name: Buying before diagnosing
what: The asset is chosen before anyone has mapped who is exposed, where and why, so the shade ends up where nobody waits.
fix: Start with the people and places at risk, then choose.

name: Built, with no one to keep it
what: It looks good for one season, then fades because no running budget or owner was set aside.
fix: Name who keeps each asset working after year one, and from which budget.
fact: The authors of a four-city study warn that without upkeep, green investments become “high-profile ribbon-cutting events but no long-term benefit”.

source.label: Hansen et al., chapter 10 in Nature-Based Solutions for Cities, 2023

name: Green without water
what: Trees, parks and green roofs go in with no water source, soil care or survival budget.
fix: Secure the water and three years of care before planting, and count trees that survive.

name: Promising degrees you haven’t measured
what: A fixed temperature drop is promised from another place’s study.
fix: Log temperatures in treated and untreated places, and report what you measured.

name: A list of activities, not a model
what: A proposal lists many activities, but none says who it protects, what it costs per unit, who owns it and what changes.
fix: For each option, name the users, the unit cost, the owner and the outcome.
